claims.content: The player left-clicks down on the great square block to select it.
The player moves the mouse to drag the selected great square towards the bottom of the board.
The player releases the mouse button (left-click up) to place the great square at the bottom of the board.
The system detects that the great square is moved at the bottom of the board, triggering the end of the game.
The player selects the 'Undo' option from the menu to cancel the last movement, causing the game to display the block positions as they were before the last movement.
The player selects the 'Redo' option from the menu to redo a movement that was previously canceled, causing the game to display the block positions as they were before the cancellation.
If the number of block movements is not lower than the highest recorded in the statistics file, the system displays the 'Simple finish Window' instead of the 'Finish Window with Statistics'.
All player statistics are frozen.
If the number of block movements is lower than the highest recorded, the 'Finish Window with Statistics' is displayed.
If the number of block movements is not lower than the highest recorded, the 'Simple finish Window' is displayed.
After the player clicks 'OK' in either finish window, the finish window is closed and the statistic window is displayed.
Player statistics (name, block movement number, time) are recorded in the statistic file if the file was correctly updated.
If the statistic file update fails (e.g., wrong permissions or disk full), an error message is displayed.
